summary: Completed E2E testing of Reassura onboarding flow. All 6 onboarding screens load correctly with OnboardingMessages component visible. All 3 map picker types (sage/blue/amber) work correctly. Found minor race condition bug in 'I'm done sharing' button navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: Clicking 'I'm done sharing' button navigates to /onboarding/demo instead of main app. The AsyncStorage.setItem() doesn't complete before router.replace('/') is called.
ui_bugs.workaround: Setting AsyncStorage directly then navigating works correctly. Main app loads when flag is pre-set.

issues: Animated: useNativeDriver not supported on web - JS fallback used

action_items: Fix race condition in handleDone: Add small delay after AsyncStorage.setItem or use callback to ensure flag is set before navigation
Suggested fix: Change handleDone to use then() chain or add explicit wait: `await AsyncStorage.setItem(...); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); router.replace('/');`
critical_code_review_comments: handleDone in invite.tsx has async timing issue where router.replace runs before AsyncStorage write completes on web
All data-testid attributes present but React Native TouchableOpacity doesn't render them as HTML attributes on web - not a bug, expected RN web behavior

rca_of_the_issue: handleDone() in invite.tsx uses `await AsyncStorage.setItem()` followed by `router.replace('/')`. On React Native Web, the AsyncStorage polyfill may not complete synchronously, causing the _layout.tsx useEffect (which checks onboardingDone on segment change) to read stale value and redirect to /onboarding/demo. Mitigation: Add explicit delay or use a state-based navigation trigger.
